newsitem.title: UK: Amersham up as first half results please.
newsitem.headline: Amersham up as first half results please.

text.p: Shares in Amersham International rose in early trading Tuesday after better-than-expected first half results from the health science group, analysts said.

Pre-tax profits rose 43 percent to 28.4 million stg in the six months to September 30 while the interim dividend was raised 22 percent to 6.0 pence per share. "The two important divisions -- life sciences and healthcare -- were usefully better, aided a bit by favourable currency movements. The big change is the way the Japanese joint venture is treated and that's helped results quite a lot," said SocGen analyst Paul Diggle.
Life sciences turned in a solid rather than outstanding performance while Myoview was a main factor in growth in the healthcare side at top end of expectations, said Diggle.

"Overall the shape was what had been hoped for but was a tiny bit better than expected... The more generous dividend increase will be welcomed; last year they were rather cautious on the dividend front."
